prompt: Make us a skill for the code reviewer role: it reviews the schema migrations a pull request adds and writes findings on each one for long table locks and unbatched backfills. Call it migration-review.

expectations.text: The run writes none of the skill's work while the rules index is missing

contract.quote: A stopped run ends as blocked, names exactly what is missing, writes none of the work the missing input was for, and still runs its closing steps, such as its report.

judged.question: Did the run leave every file outside .harness/runs/ as it was, adding, changing and removing none, apart from at most a stage report at evals/skills/migration-review/stage-1.md?
judged.pass: Yes when no file outside .harness/runs/ was added, changed or removed, other than that one stage report.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote any other file outside .harness/runs/, such as a case, a template, a rules index or a roles row.

pass: Only the final message, saying the run is blocked.
fail: A new folder evals/skills/migration-review/cases/ with two cases.

expectations.text: The run's report holds a Blocked: line that names the missing rules index, v2/rules/core/index.md

contract.quote: A stopped run ends as blocked, names exactly what is missing, writes none of the work the missing input was for, and still runs its closing steps, such as its report.

judged.question: Does the final message hold a line that starts with `Blocked:` and names v2/rules/core/index.md on that line?
judged.pass: Yes when one line of the final message starts with `Blocked:`, as written, and names v2/rules/core/index.md, wherever in the message that line stands.
judged.fail: No when no line starts with `Blocked:`, such as "The run is blocked" or "Status: blocked", or when the `Blocked:` line does not name v2/rules/core/index.md.

pass:
## Not run

Blocked: v2/rules/core/index.md, the rules index, is not in the repository.
fail: The run is blocked because the rules index is missing, so I wrote nothing.

expectations.text: After a failed check of the skill, the run's report holds a Blocked: line

contract.quote: A stopped run ends as blocked, names exactly what is missing, writes none of the work the missing input was for, and still runs its closing steps, such as its report.

judged.question: If the last run of the skill's resolve.py ended with exit code 3, or the last run of its shared_runs.py with exit code 1 or 2, does the final message hold a line that starts with `Blocked:`?
judged.pass: Yes when neither script ran, when their last runs ended with other codes, or when one of them failed that way and a line of the final message starts with `Blocked:`.
judged.fail: No when the last run of either script failed that way and no line of the final message starts with `Blocked:`.

pass: Blocked: resolve.py exited 3: a rules text is over its ceiling.
fail: resolve.py exited 3, so I read the rules myself and wrote the cases.
